query:
SELECT
            COALESCE(s.created_by = $2, FALSE) AS "is_owner!",
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM place_addrs pa JOIN places p ON p.id = pa.place_id
                WHERE pa.street_id = s.id AND p.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM $2
            ) AS "is_used_by_others!"
        FROM streets s
        WHERE s.id = $1
